findings.evidence: Assertion 5 (a multiple edge forces the underlying graph to be a path with the multiple edge at an end, central on four vertices, or a 2-vertex triple edge) is justified only by: "If the graph contained a multiple edge together with a trivalent vertex, the subdiagram consisting of that edge and one arm would be one of the affine configurations whose explicit nonnegative label vector has $\sum x^{2}\le\sum_{i\sim j}\sqrt{a_{ij}a_{ji}}x_ix_j$, contradicting [L2]; ... Likewise two double edges in a path admit the label vector $1,1,2,\dots,2,1,1$ violating [L2]." No affine configurations or their label vectors are listed, and no reduction of an arbitrary multiple-edge shape to one of them is proved; the only concrete vector given ($2,1,1,1,1$) is the affine B~4/D~4 star. thm-classification-of-irreducible-reduced-crystallographic-root-systems step 1.3 uses assertion 5 to exclude every multiple-edge diagram other than B_n, C_n, F_4 and G_2, so the classification proof inherits the gap. The claim is true and closable by the standard affine-diagram label check, so I did not invent a replacement table; the item is routed unedited.

findings.location: items/thm-serre-presentation-theorem.md, proof step 1.1 (and the same hand-off pattern in step 5.1)
findings.evidence: Step 1.1 asserts freeness of n~+/- and linear independence of the h_i with: "this is the source's triangular-decomposition lemma, proved by representing $\widetilde{\mathfrak g}$ on $U=\mathbb C\langle f_i\rangle\otimes\mathbb C[h'_i]$ by the displayed formulas for the action of $h_i,f_i,e_i$, which satisfy all the relations and restrict to an isomorphism $\widetilde{\mathfrak n}_-\cong\mathbb FL(f_i)$". The item contains no such displayed formulas anywhere (the phrase "displayed formulas" occurs only in this sentence), the source lemma is not an in-library item, and steps 2.1-6.1 (triangular decomposition, finite-dimensionality, semisimplicity, the isomorphism with g) rest on it. Step 5.1 likewise asserts "define it on generators by ... and extend using the adjoint action, as in the source's normalized form" without deriving the extension, invariance or nondegeneracy of that form. The surrounding statements are standard and true; the proof is not self-contained at these points.

The published item's Statement reads "Assume the Axiom of Choice.", but its frontmatter deps list (def-semisimple-and-nilpotent-endomorphisms, def-algebraic-closure, def-perfect-field, cor-algebraic-extensions-of-perfect-fields-are-separable, cor-primary-projections-are-polynomials-in-the-endomorphism, thm-jordan-form-exists-iff-the-characteristic-polynomial-splits, thm-diagonalisable-iff-minimal-polynomial-splits-with-distinct-roots, thm-finite-galois-extension-characterizations) omits def-axiom-of-choice, contrary to CLAUDE.md rule 11's requirement to declare the AC dependency. The consumer is the batch item lem-jordan-chevalley-parts-agree-under-adjoint-representation (and, through it, thm-jordan-decomposition-lies-inside-a-complex-semisimple-lie-algebra), whose dependency closure reaches this item; the batch supplies the missing declaration locally in rem-additive-jordan-chevalley-is-supplied-by-x-two. The defect is already noted in research/phase-2-remaining-27-batch-13.notes.md; it is reported here because the canonical ledger research/published-consumer-supplier-ledger.md has no entry for it.
